titleEn: Determine the Winner of a Bowling Game
title: 保龄球游戏的获胜者
summary: 两名玩家各有若干次投球；若某次投球的前一或前二次中出现十瓶全中，则本次得分翻倍，比较总分并返回胜者编号，平局返回零。
insight: 独立扫描每名玩家，从当前位置检查 i-1 和 i-2 是否为十，按一倍或两倍累加即可。
pitfalls: 全中翻倍影响后续两次而不是自身
两次条件同时满足也只翻一倍

solutions.title: 直接模拟两局计分
solutions.idea: 用此前两个原始投球值判断倍率。
steps: i 从零扫描，multiplier 为前一或前二值等于十时二，否则一
比较两人分数返回一、二或零

code.java: class Solution { private int score(int[] player){int total=0;for(int i=0;i<player.length;i++)total+=player[i]*((i>0&&player[i-1]==10||i>1&&player[i-2]==10)?2:1);return total;}public int isWinner(int[] player1,int[] player2){int first=score(player1),second=score(player2);return first==second?0:first>second?1:2;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun score(player:IntArray):Int{var total=0;for(i in player.indices)total+=player[i]*(if(i>0&&player[i-1]==10||i>1&&player[i-2]==10)2 else 1);return total}fun isWinner(player1:IntArray,player2:IntArray):Int{val first=score(player1);val second=score(player2);return if(first==second)0 else if(first>second)1 else 2} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int score(vector<int>& player){int total=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)player.size();++i)total+=player[i]*((i>0&&player[i-1]==10||i>1&&player[i-2]==10)?2:1);return total;}public:int isWinner(vector<int>& player1,vector<int>& player2){int first=score(player1),second=score(player2);return first==second?0:first>second?1:2;} };
